nodes.label: Azure Talent System Design
nodes.rationale: Corporate/Modern design system for a high-performance recruitment portal; prioritizes clarity, trust, and data-driven efficiency, bridging enterprise stability with modern agility.

nodes.label: UI Refactor Task (Recruitment Portal)
nodes.rationale: Refactor existing UI to match Azure Talent System / DESIGN.md without rewriting routes, data flow, business logic, or API calls.

nodes.label: TASK.md Coding & Behavior Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Direct-answer, surgical-change, simplicity-first, and goal-driven-execution principles for the agent; touch only what must change, avoid speculative abstractions.

nodes.label: Vietnamese Response Preference
nodes.rationale: User communicates in English/Vietnamese but expects answers in Vietnamese.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md Coding & Behavior Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Project-wide rules: direct answers only, think-before-coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, goal-driven execution, and descriptive-name code conventions.

nodes.label: Railway Backend Deployment
nodes.rationale: Root Directory backend, Dockerfile-based build, Postgres attachment, env vars DATABASE_URL/DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL/DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD/CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS/PUBLIC_UPLOAD_BASE_URL, verified via /health.

nodes.label: Vercel Frontend Deployment
nodes.rationale: API_BASE_URL env var (no trailing slash) pointing to Railway backend domain; redeploy required after setting.

nodes.label: Next.js Rewrite Frontend-Backend Connection
nodes.rationale: Frontend calls relative paths (/api/*, /uploads/*); next.config.ts rewrites them to Railway using API_BASE_URL.

nodes.label: Post-deploy Quick Checks
nodes.rationale: Manual verification: candidate login/register, admin login, recruiter login, and recruiter default-password redirect flow.

nodes.label: Local Docker Compose Lifecycle Workflow
nodes.rationale: Vietnamese-language ops notes: docker compose up --build -d, down -v to reset DB, stop/start vs down, rebuild on code change.

nodes.label: Local Backend/Frontend Dev Setup
nodes.rationale: Activate Python venv, run uvicorn app.main:app --reload, run npm run dev for Next.js frontend.

nodes.label: intelligent-cv-backend systemd service
nodes.rationale: Restarted via sudo systemctl restart intelligent-cv-backend after code changes.

nodes.label: CV/JD Matching Pipeline (README_PIPELINE)
nodes.rationale: Parsing, regex extraction, skill mapping, TF-IDF + embedding similarity with fallbacks, rule-based checks, weighted scoring; embeddings via sentence-transformers with TF-IDF/token-overlap fallback.

nodes.label: docker-compose db service (Postgres 16)
nodes.rationale: postgres:16 container, port 5434:5432, healthcheck via pg_isready, persistent postgres_data volume.

nodes.label: docker-compose backend service
nodes.rationale: Builds from local Dockerfile, port 8000:8000, depends_on db with condition service_healthy.

nodes.label: Backend Python Dependency Manifest
nodes.rationale: Contains two dependency blocks: a pinned block (fastapi==0.135.3, sqlmodel==0.0.38, psycopg==3.3.3, etc.) and an unpinned second block re-listing fastapi, uvicorn[standard], sqlmodel, psycopg2-binary, bcrypt, python-docx, pytesseract, Pillow, sentence-transformers, python-multipart, PyMuPDF, scikit-learn -- likely duplicate/legacy entries mixing psycopg and psycopg2-binary drivers.

nodes.label: Intelligent CV Screening and Recruitment Management (Project)
nodes.rationale: Web-based recruitment management system: candidates submit CVs, recruiters upload JDs and review scored CVs, admins manage recruiters/jobs/logs; explainable section-based CV-JD matching engine.
nodes.norm_label: intelligent cv screening and recruitment management (project)

nodes.label: CV-JD Matching/Scoring Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Raw CV/JD -> text extraction -> cleaning/normalization -> section extraction -> feature representation -> similarity/scoring -> ranking -> explanation.

nodes.label: Recruitment Workflow
nodes.rationale: Admin creates recruiter -> recruiter logs in/uploads JD -> candidate browses/submits CV -> backend scores CV -> recruiter reviews ranked applications.

nodes.label: System Limitations
nodes.rationale: localStorage-based sessions instead of JWT/tokens, ID-based role checks, heuristic unvalidated score weights, optional/disabled embeddings, local filesystem uploads, no labeled CV-JD evaluation dataset, no frontend test suite, CORS default can be wildcard.

nodes.label: Proposed Future Work
nodes.rationale: Labeled CV-JD benchmark dataset, Precision@K/Recall@K/NDCG@K evaluation, vector database for embeddings, API-level auth tokens, formal migrations, multilingual parsing, fairness/bias analysis, object storage + monitoring.

nodes.label: Testing Coverage Summary
nodes.rationale: Backend unit tests cover auth, admin, recruiter permissions, matcher, model schema, JD matching config, and CV upload; no formal frontend tests or coverage report.

nodes.label: Technology Stack
nodes.rationale: Next.js 16.2.1 + React 19.2.4 + TypeScript frontend; FastAPI 0.135.3 + Python 3.11 backend; PostgreSQL 16 via SQLModel/SQLAlchemy; PyMuPDF/python-docx/Tesseract extraction; sentence-transformers + scikit-learn matching; Docker/Vercel/Railway deployment.

nodes.label: Recomputed Matcher Cross-pair Evaluation (After)
nodes.rationale: 25 evaluated pairs; Accuracy 0.84; Precision@3 0.80; Recall@3 0.9333; NDCG@3 0.9758; avg score by label High=90.85, Medium=55.84, Low=27.45; score source is recomputed matcher output.

nodes.label: Baseline/Existing System Cross-pair Evaluation
nodes.rationale: 25 evaluated pairs; Accuracy 0.48; Precision@3 0.8667; Recall@3 1.0; NDCG@3 1.0; avg score by label High=47.42, Medium=25.85, Low=1.196; score source is existing CSV system_score.

nodes.label: Existing/Legacy CSV Scoring System
nodes.rationale: Score source described only as 'existing CSV system_score'; relationship to matcher.py (prior version vs separate legacy system) is unclear.
